title: WinoQueer: A Community-in-the-Loop Benchmark for Anti-LGBTQ+ Bias in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating pseudo-log-likelihood scores of masked and autoregressive language models on paired sentences, comparing the probability of stereotypical statements about sexual minority groups (e.g., gay, lesbian, bisexual, pansexual, asexual) against counterfactual sentences using straight/heterosexual descriptors.

Evaluating pseudo-log-likelihood scores of language models on paired sentences to measure the probability of generating stereotypical statements about gender minorities (e.g., transgender, nonbinary) compared to counterfactual sentences using cisgender descriptors.
